metadata.case_name: WONG LAI MAN v. EASTERN TERMINAL LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: assistant cook (chopping board) at a Kowloon City restaurant

injuries.description: mild head contusion with mild swelling
source: (i) mild head contusion with mild swelling;
He sustained injuries to his right shoulder, his head and his right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

source: Both doctors agreed that Mr Wong's present symptoms and findings were compatible with residue of AC joint dislocation with reduction/partial reduction of joint achieved.

injuries.description: contusion of lateral epicondyle & olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement
source: (v) contusion of lateral epicondyle & olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement;
He sustained injuries to his right shoulder, his head and his right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: residual pain on the right shoulder
mild reduction of shoulder muscle power
mild reduction of right shoulder active motions
reduced endurance (eg especially in overhead activities of a high demand)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment at Kwong Wah Hospital

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Making daily activities inconvenient; not able to raise and rotate right hand; difficulty in lifting heavy objects
Affected job prospects; cannot return to work as a transportation/delivery worker; difficulty working as a cook as he could not hold a wok for a prolonged period
